description: Implementation of AppDelegate for an iOS React Native app, handling app launch, cache management, security pinning, and configuration.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: AppDelegate class implementing app lifecycle, cache management, and security configuration for an iOS React Native app.

methods.name: application:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:
methods.description: Handles app launch, sets up initial properties, and calls configuration methods.

methods.name: sourceURLForBridge:
methods.description: Provides the JavaScript bundle URL depending on build configuration.

methods.name: concurrentRootEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether React 18 concurrent root feature is enabled.

methods.name: clearWebEditorCache
methods.description: Clears web cache if app version has changed.

methods.name: configurePinning
methods.description: Configures SSL pinning for specified domains using TrustKit.
